messages:
Evan: quick sync — we're seeing inconsistent row heights in the data table on the dashboard when buttons with icons are used. Some rows jump when actions appear. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/table-row-jump.png
Mei: that is because action buttons add 8px vertical padding on focus. We used `btn-compact` for lists but left its vertical padding same as default. Propose `btn-inline` token with height 32px and no vertical padding so rows stay stable.
Carlos: agree. Also a11y: when action menu opens, keyboard focus goes to the menu but table row doesn't get aria-selected. Recommend adding `aria-expanded` on the menu trigger and manage `aria-activedescendant` for row navigation.
Nora: copy tweak: the small inline button currently shows tooltip "More". context is row-level options for model endpoints. Suggest "Actions" or a more descriptive label like "Endpoint actions" — tooltips should match aria-labels.
QAbot: failing regtest: `table-row-stability` on 375px width. Repro steps: open table, hover row, click action, observe layout shift. Snapshot id: b3c4d.
Evan: for spacing tokens, could we create `row-action-compact-gap` and `row-action-regular-gap` to make intent clear? default to `regular` for comfort. update docs to recommend `compact` only in dense list views.
Mei: implementation note: I'll add `btn-inline` variant and keep visual height stable using `line-height` + fixed `min-height`. sample CSS:
```
.btn-inline { height: 32px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; }
.table-row { align-items: center; }
```
Carlos: menu focus handling — ensure pressing Escape returns focus to the trigger and row remains focusable. Also ensure screen reader announces "Actions menu opened" via live region rather than shifting focus to toast.
Nora: toast interaction: small success toast appears "Action complete" but it interrupts NVDA reads. Toasts should use `aria-live="polite"` and not move DOM focus. For failures use `assertive` but be careful with modals open.
Evan: agree. Plan: add `btn-inline`, add tokens, update aria attributes, and change toasts to `aria-live` polite unless error. We'll add a tiny migration note for components that used `btn-compact` in lists. Thanks all :rocket:
